description: Incident resolve on an END execution-listener chain (#1406 finding 7). `inc` is a script task (`counter + 1`) whose end listener's job type `=auditType` fails: resolving re-runs the listener (incident again until `auditType` is set) but NOT the script — counter stays 1 (finding 5). `work` has end listeners `first` and `=secondType`; the second fails after `first` completed, and resolving restarts the chain at index 0 — Zeebe re-creates `first`'s job, then `second`. `work`'s non-idempotent output mapping (`counter + 100 -> counter`) IS re-applied by the restart — Zeebe re-runs the completing step (counter 101 -> 201).
